exports.name: utf8RoundTripScore
exports.description: Write and read UTF-8 strings containing ASCII, Greek, and emoji characters through a Buffer.

exports.name: bytePrimitiveScore
exports.description: Write a generated byte pattern and read it back byte-by-byte with a checksum loop.

exports.name: copyAndPeekScore
exports.description: Read a prefix from one Buffer, transfer the remaining bytes into another Buffer, and score both paths.

exports.name: segmentStressScore
exports.description: Write many small string and byte fragments to stress Buffer segment handling and read them back.

exports.name: invalidReadScore
exports.description: Attempt an over-large read and then verify the remaining bytes through the exception path.

description: AI-authored Kotlin/Wasm harness compiled against the human-authored kotlinx-io 0.9.0 core library, exercising UTF-8 buffers, byte primitives, transfers, segment stress, and exceptional reads.
notes: Built as an optimized Kotlin/Wasm WASI library fixture. The exported score functions intentionally fold richer library results into i32 values so the corpus runner can assert behavior without requiring string return support.
